configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.eef_sequence.prompt: Use short sequences near contact, grasping, release, other state changes, precise operations, or when information is missing and the situation is uncertain. Use longer sequences only for predictable motion with sufficient information. Several short completed moves can share one model decision to save model budget, but a long first move may interrupt the sequence before any later move executes.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.
